author: IamMingus
quote:
This game represents absolute dystopia - biggest financial opening for any media ever and its entirely built upon blind brand loyalty rather than any true merit
All aspects of the industry have been bought out and rigged to boost online praise for this game (look at the **** critic score man) 
The game is shallow, clunky, boring, tedious, excessive, outdated, unoptimised, painfully narcissistic and is a woefully buggy mess
Not to mention how its being used to further push anti-consumer practices and pricing
